title: Everybody Huang chung tonight
description: FROM my point of view, the salacious news that dominated the headlines this past week, to wit, the revelations about the multiple extramarital affairs of Nvidia founder and chief executive officer Jensen Huang, is the clearest sign yet that the artificial intelligence (AI) industry is headed for an apocalypse. Not a crash that will lead to its extinction — a forum that I attended on Friday, which I will discuss next week, convinced me of that — but rather a long-overdue reconfiguration that will be painful to a great many people and business interests. Plus, on a certain low-brow level — a couple of my editorial friends and I have been behaving like absolute children with this story — the saga is simply hilarious.
